capabilities: Render Tekken notation inside fight code blocks
Parse flexible or weak notation syntax
Customize notation colors, effects and rounding in settings
Select render styles (default, icon, expand) and notation sizes
Add or override notation abbreviations and extend tooltips
extras: Focused on Tekken; the description notes it is only partially useful for other fighting games such as Guilty Gear.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to display fighting-game notation, which is otherwise hard to read as plain text.

relations.evidence: Obsidian Tekken Notation – Idea and inspiration.

summary: Code-block renderer that turns Tekken move notation into readable, styled output with colors, icons, sizes and tooltips.
